notes: On the Pi, serial_bridge and smoke_test read ~/smartlib/pi-config.local.json by default — set firebase_credentials_path there to the real key path (rename your downloaded *-firebase-adminsdk-*.json to firebase-adminsdk.json or point to its actual name). pi-config.example.json is only a repo template. __SMARTLIB_HOME__ expands to ~/smartlib or $SMARTLIB_HOME. FSR: fsr_presence.mode zero vs threshold keys; away_timer_seconds; serial_bridge flags. Never commit secrets.
